description: Unit tests for OpenClawKit's ChatViewModel, validating chat message flow, session management, model selection, and event handling.

classes.name: CallbackBox
classes.description: A thread-safe container for passing callback values between asynchronous operations.

classes.name: AsyncGate
classes.description: An actor used to synchronize asynchronous events, acting as a gate for controlled continuation.

classes.name: AsyncCounter
classes.description: An actor for maintaining a thread-safe integer counter.

classes.name: TestChatTransportState
classes.description: Holds internal counters and state for the TestChatTransport mock.

classes.name: TestChatTransport
classes.description: A mock implementation of OpenClawChatTransport for testing, simulating responses and events.

methods.name: seqGapClearsPendingRunsAndAutoRefreshesHistory
